registeredBefore: first access, fetch, or view of any 2025-09 race data

baseline.name: Android v0.15.16 AverageRoiReferenceStrategy.forecast
baseline.formScore: (nationalWinRate??0)*5.2+(localWinRate??0)*2.6+(motorTop2??0)*0.22+(boatTop2??0)*0.08+max(0,(.22-averageStart)*58) when present+max(-5,(6.95-exhibitionTime)*18) when present+max(-4,(.18-previewStart)*32) when present
baseline.course: preview course if present, else lane; invalid numeric course prior 0
baseline.probability: Plackett-Luce weights exp((score-maxScore)/14) for six boats, P(a,b,c)=w[a]/sum(w)*w[b]/(sum(w)-w[a])*w[c]/(sum(w)-w[a]-w[b]); full 120 permutations in lane 1..6 lexicographic order
baseline.missingNumeric: nullable Kotlin fields yield zero contribution; valid six-boat input required
baseline.parityGate: On existing July-August usable 9583 rows reproduce prior reference metric counts and rounded logloss/Brier, top1/top2/top4/top8 and first Top1/Top2 exactly before September scores are trusted; independent synthetic formula tests against Kotlin semantics

population.sourceRaces: all program race keys across exactly 30 September calendar dates
population.eligibleSettled: exactly six matching boat numbers and racer IDs in program and result, complete unique finishing ranks 1..6; infer winner combo from ordered finish ranks alone without reading payout data
population.modelUsable: six distinct positive racer registration IDs and fixed r4 pre-race required fields and valid six course permutation; any missing required input counted as Model A missing
population.comparison: intersection of eligible settled and Model A usable; exact identical sorted race keys for baseline and Model A; no fallback into Model A; baseline available on six-boat races and reported coverage separately

history.process: for each September day create all pre-race snapshots from prior-day state, infer both forecasters, then batch apply that day's eligible usable race outcomes; same-day outcomes never enter snapshots
history.updates: exact r4 PlayerHistory.enrich semantics for eligible-and-pre-race-usable races; do not impute missing-input results

evaluation.brier: sum across all 120 of (p-onehot)^2 per race, race mean
evaluation.ece: 10 equal-width [0,1] bins of highest trifecta probability; last includes 1
evaluation.rankingTies: fixed 120 lexicographic permutation order and lane number; stable sort

bootstrap.unit: calendar day, with all paired races in selected days
bootstrap.dayResampling: draw 30 days with replacement per replicate; race-weighted pooled mean of per-race ModelA-minus-baseline losses; same days/races for both models
bootstrap.interval: 2.5th and 97.5th empirical percentiles (95%) for logloss and Brier differences, no one-sided reinterpretation

evaluation.primaryPass: ModelA logloss point < baseline; logloss 95% CI upper <0; ModelA Brier point < baseline
evaluation.secondarySafety: ModelA first-place Top1 >= baseline and trifecta Top4 >= baseline (point estimates); venue/day diagnostics descriptive only
evaluation.decision: PASS_FORECAST_HOLDOUT iff all guards and parity and coverage and primaryPass and secondarySafety; FAIL_FORECAST_HOLDOUT when valid evaluation misses metric gates; INCONCLUSIVE_FORECAST_HOLDOUT when source coverage/history/model/parity validity is materially uncertain; never retune after outcome
